scheme_name: State Scholarship for Class 6th to 10th (Denotified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic )
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the Denotified, Nomadic, or Semi‑Nomadic community
Applicant must be studying in Class 6th to 10th
Eligibility is retained even if the student has failed one year
No need to reapply for renewal if the student continues in the same class category (6th‑8th or 9th‑10th)
benefits_summary: Annual scholarship for 10 months ranging from ₹200 to ₹1,200, with higher amounts for higher classes and for girls.
